logical_fallacies.example: Concluding a policy is effective based on a single study without considering other evidence.
logical_fallacies.location: A growing chorus of critics is asking why it took the federal government until the end of the week to kick the evacuation into gear.
logical_fallacies.explanation: Critics questioning the timing of the evacuation does not necessarily lead to the conclusion that the policy was ineffective without considering other factors.
